name: Uttarakhand Mega Industrial and Investment Policy - 2021
benefit:
***Classification of Projects Based on Fixed Capital Investment:***

  - **Large Projects** – ₹50 crore to ₹75 crore.  - **Mega Projects** – Projects with a capital investment of more than ₹75 crore and up to ₹200 crore.   - **Ultra Mega Projects** – Projects with a capital investment of more than ₹200 crore and up to ₹400 crore in plant and machinery.   - **Super Ultra Mega Projects** – Projects
_eligibility_text: 1. Any person who wishes to invest in Uttarakhand under the "Mega Industry and Investment Policy" is eligible.
